newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Simsmetal in U.K. and U.S. acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Simsmetal in U.K. and U.S. acquisitions.

text.p: Metal recycling group Simsmetal Ltd said on Tuesday its unit Sims Bird Ltd of the United Kingdom plans to purchase Dorset-based metals group D.G. Corbin and Sons for an undisclosed sum.

Simsmetal also said its U.S. unit Simsmetal America had signed a letter of intent, subject to completion of due diligence and approval of the board, to purchase the assets and business of Peck Recycling of Richmond, Virginia.
It did not disclose an amount for the Peck purchase.
Earlier, Simsmetal reported a 35 percent fall in net profit to A$22.07 million for the nine months ended March 31, 1997.
